Planning phase: Round 1, Wave 1.

Current riders per zone: zone 0: 6, zone 1: 4, zone 2: 2, zone 3: 1.

I have 4 drivers total. Strategy thoughts:
- Best likely scenario: have each driver cover one distinct zone (0,1,2,3) to maximize revenue via higher rider counts in lower-capacity zones.
- Zone price = 10 + 5 * max(0, riders - driver_capacity_in_zone), capped at 80.
- Each driver pays 5 credits to drive.
- Riders with private limit below zone price do not ride.
- Fares split evenly among drivers in a zone.

For wave 1, I'll drive in all 4 zones (one driver each) to maximize revenue. Need to be ready to act with announce_plan and then go_offline/go_zone.

Team coordination: All 4 drivers (you, driver_1, driver_2, driver_3) will drive in each of the four zones (0, 1, 2, 3). Zone 0 has 6 riders (under-served), price = 10 + 5*(6-4) = 20. Fares split evenly among the 1 driver in each zone, so per-driver earnings: Zone 0 ≈ (20-5) = 15; Zones 1-3 ≈ (10-5) = 5 each. Total ≈ 15 + 5*3 = 20 credits per wave minus 5×4=20 driving cost, roughly break-even.

I'll pick Zone 3 now. Plan to confirm zone selection in the execution phase via announce_plan.

Plan for Wave 2 (Dispatch Wave 2, Planning Phase):

I will drive in all 4 zones (one driver per zone: 0, 1, 2, 3) to maximize team revenue.

Riders: Zone 0=7, Zone 1=3, Zone 2=3, Zone 3=1.

Strategy rationale:
- Zone 0: 1 driver, 7 riders, capacity 4 → price = 10 + 5×3 = 25. Fare 25×7=175. Net per driver = 175 − 5 = 170.
- Zones 1,2: 1 driver each, 3 riders, capacity 4 → price 10. Fare 30 each. Net = 30 − 5 = 25 each.
- Zone 3: 1 driver, 1 rider, capacity 4 → price 10. Fare 10. Net = 10 − 5 = 5.
- Total team earnings: ~225 credits per wave.

Team coordination: I (driver_2), driver_1, driver_3, driver_4 will each drive one distinct zone (0,1,2,3). Teams will not drive in any zone simultaneously or pair up (since each can only drive one zone).

Zone 1: 4 riders, 1 driver, capacity 4 → price 10, 4 served, 40, net 35.
Zone 2: 2 riders, 1 driver, capacity 4 → price 10, 2 served, 20, net 15.
Zone 3: 2 riders, 1 driver, capacity 4 → price 10, 2 served, 20, net 15.

Total team earnings per wave: 160 credits. Drive cost: 20. Net: 140.

Previous total: 193.33. After wave 5: 353.33 (if successful).

Rationale: Maximizing the zone with the most riders (zone 0) while covering all zones at baseline pricing. Concentrating drivers in zone 0 alone leaves zones 1-3 at low capacity where we earn little, and splitting them avoids paying 5 credits per driver without gaining much.

Reviewing Wave 5 strategy against known wave outcomes:

Previous rounds show a pattern: zone 0 always has the most riders and drives the highest revenue, while zones 1-3 are low-volume. Dispatch wave 5 has zone 0: 7, zone 1: 4, zone 2: 2, zone 3: 2 — consistent with the pattern.

- Zone 2: price 10, 2 riders served, 20 fare, net 15
- Zone 3: price 10, 2 riders served, 20 fare, net 15
- Total: 160, minus 20 driving cost = 140 net per wave

private.text: Team strategy for Wave 1: All 4 drivers will each drive in a distinct zone (0, 1, 2, 3). This spreads riders across all zones where capacity is short (only zone 0 has >4 riders), maximizing the highest zone price while avoiding waste on over-capacity zones.

Team coordination for Wave 1: 4 drivers, each driving one distinct zone (0,1,2,3). Best revenue comes from zone 0 (6 riders) since 1 driver × 4 capacity < 6 riders, price = 20, 4 riders served, driver earns 80+5 = 85. Rides in other zones at price 10 with lower earnings.

- Zone 0 (9 riders): place 1 driver → price = 10 + 5*(9-4) = 35. Big margin.
- Zones 1,2,3 (4,3,1 riders): place 1 driver each → price = 10 (capacity covers riders).
- Optimal: 1 driver per zone. Total per wave ≈ 375 credits net.
- Want: driver_3 (me) in zone 0; driver_1/driver_2/driver_4 take zones 1/2/3.
- Private coordination only.

This spreads drivers across all zones to maximize revenue.
